map.根据建筑面积、层数与防火分区，计算火灾报警区域与探测区域划分方案: Compute the fire alarm zone and detector zone plan from building area, number of floors and fire compartments.
map.探测器保护面积 A = f(探测器类型, 房间净高)：点型感烟净高≤6m 取 8: Detector coverage area A = f(detector type, room clear height): spot smoke ≤6 m → 80 m², decreasing above 6 m; the alarm zone follows the fire compartment, and one alarm zone should consist of one fire compartment or floor.
map.报警区域应按防火分区或楼层划分，一个报警区域宜由一个防火分区或同层相邻防火分区组: Alarm zones should be divided by fire compartment or floor; one alarm zone should consist of one fire compartment or same-floor adjacent fire compartments
map.高层建筑每个防火分区为一个报警区域: In a high-rise building, each fire compartment is one alarm zone
map.报警区域不宜跨越防火分区: An alarm zone should not span fire compartments
map.探测区域应按独立房（套）间划分，一个探测区域面积不宜超过 500m²: Detector zones should be divided by independent room (unit); a detector zone should not exceed 500 m²
map.从主要出入口能看清内部，且面积不超过 1000m² 的房间可划为一个探测区域: A room whose interior can be seen clearly from the main entrance and whose area does not exceed 1000 m² may be one detector zone
map.点型感烟探测器保护面积：房间高度≤6m时约60~80m²（依据空间形状）: Spot smoke detector coverage area: about 60-80 m² when the room height ≤6 m (depending on the space shape)
map.本工具依据《火灾自动报警系统设计规范》GB 50116 提供分区建议，实际设计须: This tool provides zoning recommendations based on the Code for Design of Automatic Fire Alarm Systems (GB 50116); actual design must be determined together with the building floor plan.
map.新建或改造建筑按防火分区与探测区域上限划分报警区域，确定探测器数量。: For new or renovated buildings, divide alarm zones by fire compartment and the detector-zone upper limit and determine the number of detectors.
map.既有建筑消防改造时复核探测区域面积是否超过单只探测器保护上限。: In the fire-safety renovation of existing buildings, re-check whether the detector-zone area exceeds the coverage limit per detector.
map.消防控制室图纸标注报警/探测区域编号，便于故障定位与联动控制。: Mark alarm/detector zone numbers on drawings in the fire-control room for easy fault location and interlock control.
map.12000 m²、6 层建筑的探测器配置: Detector configuration for a 12000 m², 6-storey building
map.12000 m²、6 层、每层 2 个防火分区）：共 12 个报警区域、24 个: 12000 m², 6 floors, 2 fire compartments per floor): 12 alarm zones and 24 detector zones in total; using spot smoke detectors with about 80 m² coverage per unit, each detector zone needs about 7 units, totaling about 150 detectors, meeting the layout requirement at this building height.
map.报警区域和探测区域有什么区别？: What is the difference between an alarm zone and a detector zone?
map.报警区域按防火分区划分（一个防火分区可对应一个报警区域），是报警与联动的基本单元: An alarm zone is divided by fire compartment (one fire compartment may correspond to one alarm zone) and is the basic unit for alarm and interlock; a detector zone is a smaller detection unit within the alarm zone, its area constrained by the coverage limit per detector, used to locate the fire point precisely.
map.单只探测器保护面积怎么取？: How to choose the coverage area per detector?
map.取决于探测器类型、房间高度、顶棚坡度与火灾类型，常见点型感烟在一般场所约 60~: It depends on the detector type, room height, ceiling slope and fire class; a common spot smoke detector covers about 60-80 m² per unit in ordinary locations; the specific value must follow the table lookup in GB 50116 and cannot simply use a fixed number.
map.根据建筑层数、面积、防火分区及房间高度，计算火灾报警区域、探测区域划分方案及探测: Based on the number of floors, area, fire compartments and room height, compute the fire alarm zone and detector zone plan and estimate the number of detectors.
